title: Why America Gets More Tornadoes Than Anywhere Else
description: The United States sees around 1,200 tornadoes in a typical year, more than any other country. The reason is the shape of the continent.
comment: Have you ever seen a tornado in real life?

scenes.narration: The United States gets more tornadoes than any other country on Earth.
About 1,200 touch down there in a typical year.
The reason is geography. Warm, wet air flows north from the Gulf of Mexico.
Cold, dry air drops down from Canada, and hot, dry air drifts in from the deserts to the west.
Where they collide over the flat Great Plains, giant storms start to spin.
And no mountain range runs east to west to keep those air masses apart.
